theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_elc2_hessian_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (Ψ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 3 Ψ → ∀ ε : ℝ, ∃ MB LB : ℝ, 0 ≤ MB ∧ 0 ≤ LB ∧ (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ‖P‖ ≤ ε → ∀ Q Q' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P Q Q'| ≤ MB * ‖Q‖ * ‖Q'‖) ∧ ∀ P P' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ‖P‖ ≤ ε → ‖P'‖ ≤ ε → ∀ Q Q' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P Q Q' - fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P' Q Q'| ≤ LB * ‖P - P'‖ * ‖Q‖ * ‖Q'‖
